# Getting help

| You want to | Go to |
| --- | --- |
| Find out how something works | The [user guides](https://github.com/Youzini-afk/Varin/blob/main/packages/docs/README.md), starting with the [quickstart](https://github.com/Youzini-afk/Varin/blob/main/packages/docs/content/docs/quickstart.mdx) and [troubleshooting](https://github.com/Youzini-afk/Varin/blob/main/packages/docs/content/docs/troubleshooting.mdx) |
| Ask a question the guides don't answer | [Q&A](https://github.com/Youzini-afk/Varin/discussions/categories/q-a) in Discussions |
| Talk through an idea or a larger change | [Ideas](https://github.com/Youzini-afk/Varin/discussions/categories/ideas) |
| Share an extension, workflow or setup | [Show and tell](https://github.com/Youzini-afk/Varin/discussions/categories/show-and-tell) |
| Report something that is broken | A [bug report](https://github.com/Youzini-afk/Varin/issues/new?template=bug.yml) with the version, how you installed Varin, and steps to reproduce |
| Ask for a specific change | A [feature request](https://github.com/Youzini-afk/Varin/issues/new?template=feature.yml) |
| Report a vulnerability | The [private reporting form](https://github.com/Youzini-afk/Varin/security/advisories/new). Never post it in public; see the [security policy](SECURITY.md) |
| Raise a conduct concern | The private channel in the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md#enforcement) |

Search Discussions and Issues first; an answer may already be there. When you post, say which version and platform you use (desktop, web, Docker or mobile) and which model provider is involved, if any. Remove API keys, tokens, private prompts and file contents from logs and screenshots before sharing them.

Announcements about releases and larger changes are posted in [Announcements](https://github.com/Youzini-afk/Varin/discussions/categories/announcements).
